definitions.meaning: An immutable dataset version whose declared mapping, validation, publication, and lineage obligations have evidence for one run.
A content-addressed reference to data bytes; RWO carries the reference and never the bulk data.
The single logical authority for accepted run transitions, receipts, checkpoints, and their hash chain.
A source position accepted only after its corresponding dataset version is durably published.
Evidence that a content-addressed dataset version was atomically installed or already existed with identical bytes.
Invalid material retained with validation findings and no publication authority.
A physical accepted-history binding whose per-run chain is serialized and guarded by PostgreSQL transactions.
A content-addressed PostgreSQL publication containing one immutable logical set of normalized observations.
